craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 1. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Now the initiation giving immediate departure is set forth: from that
moment, or from enjoyment, at body's fall one may go to Śiva — so hint
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā
